technology: Apache Commons Codec / Java / Git-compatible tree identifiers and Unicode ordering
error_description: GitIdentifiers can compute a tree identifier that differs from git write-tree when directory entries include certain Unicode names outside the Basic Multilingual Plane.
i_base: GitIdentifiers.TreeIdBuilder orders DirectoryEntry values before computing a tree identifier.
Java String.compareTo orders UTF-16 code units.
Git tree sorting compares name bytes as unsigned byte values, with a special slash convention for directory names.
Supplementary-plane characters can sort differently under UTF-16 code-unit comparison and UTF-8 byte comparison.
The regression test compares the produced identifier with an identifier pinned from git write-tree.

ccdg.details: Tree entries are sorted before the identifier is computed.
UTF-16 code-unit order differs from Git's defined byte order for some names.
The comparator must reproduce the external Git tree ordering rule.
Changing the order of serialized entries changes the resulting tree identifier.

ground_truth.entity: sort key for Unicode tree entry names
ground_truth.operation: order directory entries before computing treeId
